mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_invite_code (id, code, created_by, status, expire_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{createdBy}, #{status}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_invite_code WHERE created_by = #{createdBy} AND status = 0 AND expire_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

SELECT c.id, c.code, CASE WHEN c.status = 0 AND c.expire_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 3 ELSE c.status END AS status, (c.status = 0 AND c.expire_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS expired, c.expire_at, c.used_at, c.created_at, c.used_by, u.Username AS used_by_username FROM ai_invite_code c LEFT JOIN "User" u ON u.Id = c.used_by WHERE c.created_by = #{createdBy} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_invite_code SET status = 1, used_by = #{usedBy}, used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE code = #{code} AND status = 0 AND expire_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
